description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page file is written by hand. It holds an EscrowOpened at block 10 that counts, and an EscrowReleased at block 12 whose index is an integer literal 5000 digits long. That is far past 2^53 - 1, so it is not a safe integer and the event is malformed (clauses 7 and 14), however long the literal is; Python must not refuse the page for it. Expected: complete true, status complete; covered 0 to 99; gaps none; totals escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 0, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 1; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1).
